parameters:
There's something written here, but I
can't read it. It doesn't look like
Eastern script either...
list._original:
何か書いてありますが読めませんね。
東方文字でもないような……

parameters:
This is Ainu script, it is. Let me
see...
list._original:
カンムイ文字じゃな、これは。
どれどれ……

parameters:
"Soul Ritual"... "Treasure Hall"?
...Hmm, parts of it are worn away. I
can't make it all out.
list._original:
「魂の祭事」……「宝殿」……？
……ぬう、ところどころ崩れておってよく分からん。

parameters:
Being able to read any of it is
impressive. I've never seen characters
like these before.
list._original:
読めるだけでも感服。
斯様な字は初めて見ました。

parameters:
The old youkai used to write in this.
Let's see... "history"... "serpent"...
list._original:
昔の怪異が使っとったんじゃよ。
ええと……「歴史」……「蛇」……

むきゃっ！
な、なんです！？

parameters: What was that all of a sudden?!

Seems it was guarding this place. If we
could defeat it―
list._original:
ここを守っておったようじゃな。
それに勝てたのならば──

parameters:
―then there may be something to gain
here.
list._original: ──得るものもあるやもしれんぞ。

parameters:
The door to the building ahead seems to
have opened.
list._original: 先にある建物の扉が開いたようだ。
入れと言わんばかりに。

parameters:
There may be more guardians waiting for
us... Let's proceed with caution.
list._original:
更なる守り手が控えている可能性も……
注意深く進みましょう。

parameters:
It's a corpse. This... doesn't seem to
be human.
list._original:
亡骸だ。
これは……人のものではないようだ。
